_doc: Play-engine tuning. Distances in yards, speeds in yards/second, times in seconds, probabilities in per-mille (out of 1000). Ratings are 0-99. 'per' = change per rating point.

user._doc: human controls: juke/spin make the next tackle harder for moveSeconds (bonus in per-mille, scaled by the carrier's juke/spin rating); burst = brief speed boost; throws: power 0 = lob (slower, higher), 1 = bullet

schemes._doc: Run schemes and option/RPO timing. pullStep = yards a puller drops before running the line; drawHandoff = seconds of pass-set before the draw handoff; keyCrashPerMille = how often the option key crashes on the back; readMisread* = QB misreads the option/RPO key (per awareness point missing below 99); comboSeconds = zone double team before climbing; screenRelease = when the line lets rushers through.

pa._doc: Play action: fakeSeconds = QB/RB fake; defenders who aren't rushing bite for biteBase + bitePerMissing x (99 - play recognition) seconds (x the game's run-tendency multiplier, x cornerMult for corners), stepping biteStep yards toward the line; bootleg roll-out width/depth in yards.

userDefense._doc: Defensive control mode (a human controls one defender). dive: tackle attempt from diveRange yards with diveBonus per-mille; a miss stuns diveMissStun s, a dive at nothing diveWhiffStun s. strip: for stripSeconds the tackle chance drops stripTacklePenalty but fumble chance x stripFumbleMult. swat: within swatRange of the catch point during swatSeconds, catch chance -swatCatchPenalty and INT chance +swatIntBonus. manualHold: seconds after a manual switch before auto-switch resumes.

presnap._doc: Pre-snap layer. Motion speed = max speed x jogMult (jet: jetMult); the AI snaps a jet when the motion man is jetSnapDistance yards from the ball, other motions at their end (motionMaxSeconds cap). A jet sweep carrier snapped at speed runs jetBoost x for jetBoostSeconds; handoff jetHandoff s after the snap. Man defenders follow motion at followMult speed. Press: a pressed receiver is held jamBase + jamPer x (press - release) s (max jamMax); press/bail corner depth in yards; a press corner beaten off the line reacts pressBeatPenalty s later. showDepth = how close a shown blitzer stands. dlShift/lbShift yards. slideBias = extra yards a sliding lineman 'sees' on the far side. Hard count: offside chance base + per x (70 - DL play recognition) per-mille, else false-start chance. playClock = seconds to snap.

special._doc: Special teams (M6). Ball flight: gravity, linear air drag per kind (per second), launch elevation per kind (degrees), launch speed = speedBase + speedPer x (kickPower - 50) yd/s at full power, minPower = fraction of that at zero power (squib/onside multiply it). Errors (uniform, per kick): aim = aimErrBase + aimErrPer x (99 - kickAccuracy) radians; power = powerErrBase + powerErrPer x (99 - kickAccuracy); pressure (last 2 minutes of the 4th/OT) x pressureMult, field goals from longFgFrom+ x longFgMult. Wind: acceleration windAccel yd/s^2 per mph while airborne. Curve: up to curveAccel yd/s^2 sideways. Bounces: restitution, friction, random scatter; rolling friction yd/s^2. Catching: within catchRange yards and below catchHeight; chance catchBase + catchPer x (catching - 70), minus catchTraffic with a cover man within 2 yards; fielding a bouncing ball fieldBase + fieldPer x (catching - 70) per try. Loose balls: recoverBase + recoverPer x (catching - 60) per try within recoverRange; the kicking team may only recover a kickoff after onsideTravel yards. downRange: a cover man this close downs a dying punt. Returners fair-catch when a cover man is within fairCatchEta seconds; kneel when caught kneelDepth+ yards deep. Timing: kickoff approach, punt snap + get-off, FG operation (seconds). Blocks per-mille: blockBase + blockPer x (best rusher - protection), x blockModeMult (block call) / safeModeMult (safe call), x puntBlockMult / patBlockMult. Goal posts: half width and crossbar height in yards, end line at y=110.
